mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_db.payments(order_id, amount, status) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{amount}, #{status}) ON CONFLICT (order_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_db.payments SET status = 'COMPLETED' WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE payment_db.payments SET status = 'FAILED' WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE payment_db.payments SET status = 'REFUNDED' WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status = 'FAILED'
